answer: A new agent cannot spawn: it must serve an apprenticeship under one established mentor, who may sponsor only a few newcomers each year and stakes reputation on each one. The apprentice completes supervised tasks over weeks, crossing an oasis of easy work into a canyon of harder cases, before earning full standing. A sybil farmer would need a distinct mentor slot and weeks of real work per fake identity, and one exposed fake shatters the mentor's ivory seal of trust. Limit: honest newcomers wait in line, and a corrupt mentor ring could still trade slots until audits catch it.
